parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['team_name','standup_date','updates'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const updates=Array.isArray(body.updates)?body.updates:[];if(updates.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'updates must be a non-empty array'}}];const formattedUpdates=updates.slice(0,20).map(u=>({name:(u.name||'Unknown').trim(),role:u.role||'',yesterday:(u.yesterday||u.done||'').trim().slice(0,400),today:(u.today||u.plan||'').trim().slice(0,400),blockers:(u.blockers||u.blocked||'').trim().slice(0,300),notes:(u.notes||'').slice(0,200)})).filter(u=>u.yesterday||u.today);if(formattedUpdates.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'No valid updates with content found'}}];return[{json:{valid:true,teamName:body.team_name.trim(),standupDate:body.standup_date,sprintName:body.sprint_name||'',sprintGoal:body.sprint_goal||'',updates:formattedUpdates,recipientEmails:Array.isArray(body.recipient_emails)?body.recipient_emails:(body.recipient_emails||'').split(',').map(e=>e.trim()).filter(Boolean),slackChannel:body.slack_channel||'',replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You summarize async team standup updates for engineering and product teams. You identify patterns across individual updates: shared blockers, converging work, risks to the sprint goal, and what needs manager attention. You write for a busy team lead who wants the signal, not a re-listing of individual updates. Always respond in valid JSON only.
